rules.requirement: Pure self-owned kernel; no DOM/React/HTML transport/persistence imports into core; new APIs explicitly proposed.
Preserve AST constructors through engine runtime sidecar IDs; same logical node retains ID, imports allocate new IDs, no IDs serialized.
Document transactions increment revision once; observable stateVersion and explicit selectionEpoch have distinct semantics.
Model positions use UTF-16 text offsets or container child boundaries with affinity; no surrogate-half points or atomic-node interior.
Each operation and normalization emits composable forward/inverse maps; split/join/remove/move preserve valid selection and identity.
User character/word deletion uses declared deterministic segmentation service; no code-unit fallback or silent Unicode normalization.
Guard/compile/apply/map/normalize/validate/commit is atomic; no partial state/history/revision mutation on rejection.
Captured expected session/revision/selection context and idempotent request identity must match at dispatch; no stale restamping.
Typed model commands cover text/blocks/lists/marks/links/slices and preserve unrelated content; no DOM mutation bypass.
Deterministic rule order to fixed point; detect changed digest cycles/pass cap; reject nonconverging candidate with no partial commit.
Immutable snapshots and synchronous ordered publication; reentrant mutations rejected; observer fault does not roll back accepted transaction.
One engine history per instance, semantic burst boundaries, explicit composition group, redo invalidation only on accepted new content edit.
Separate parent acceptance/current content/server-saved witnesses; exact captured B may be acknowledged while C remains dirty; no stale baseline rollback.
Single DOM adapter translates input paths into commands; reconcile noncancelable native input without trusting whole live innerHTML as authority.
Keep transient IME buffer outside committed document/history; one validated final transaction, no duplicate beforeinput/final input/blur commit.
Invalid composition/unexpected input retains safe candidate in memory while authorized, blocks Save, and never silently cancels content.
Preserve InkForgeEditor/ref/props compatibility, immutable external-store snapshot and host engine ownership under Strict Mode.
Registry/type/schema/command/serializer/mapping conflicts rejected before enable; plugin observation/async work never bypasses fences.
Finite document/operation/normalization/history/checkpoint/mapping/candidate budgets, validated before commit; no hidden non-undoable overflow.
Read-only/suspend and terminal dispose distinct; auth hard termination clears protected candidate/model/history/caches and late callbacks stay inert.
No persisted cms.richText v1/legacy blocks-runs mutation or automatic enabling of source/raw/media/plugin capabilities.
Standalone public controller/HTML bridge supports LIB-05 proposed ports with no Builder dependency, mixed native-engine history, or auto-save.

stateCounters.revision: Starts at 0 per new session; one increment per accepted document transaction including undo/redo
stateCounters.stateVersion: Monotonic across engine instance lifetime; one increment per observable state publication
stateCounters.selectionEpoch: Starts at 0 per session; user caret/selection intent changes only; mapping references source revision
